usdc.note: Circle's official Base Sepolia testnet USDC, confirmed on-chain (symbol/decimals read via cast, not assumed).

todo.ownership: Owner is still the deployer (0x0141781Aad86A023FaC70C6Aad0A8E7253164DB6), left that way so the same key that deployed could also run addAllowedPaymentToken/queueSweepCap/applySweepCap. Unlike the Arbitrum One mainnet deployment, this proxy was deliberately NOT handed to the 0x0b43A81e... multisig — doing so before allowlisting a payment token and setting a sweep cap would have locked this testnet contract out of any owner-only configuration (nobody here holds that multisig's key).
todo.verification: Not verified on Basescan — ETHERSCAN_API_KEY in evm/.env is blank. Run `forge verify-contract --chain 84532 <implementation> src/TakumiPay.sol:TakumiPay` once a Basescan (Etherscan v2 unified) key is available.
todo.nativeToken: Base Sepolia ETH is a normal separate asset (unlike Arc's USDC-is-gas aliasing), so address(0) was left un-allowlisted — only USDC is enabled for payments. Add native ETH via addAllowedPaymentToken(address(0)) + its own sweep cap if native payments are wanted.
todo.withdrawalDelay: Left at 0 for continued testnet configurability. Raise via queueWithdrawalDelay/applyWithdrawalDelay before this contract is trusted with anything beyond test funds.
